name: Easy Aerobic Spin — Pre-Conditioning
focus: Light aerobic movement, test back response, easy Z2 conversational effort

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 80-85 rpm, HR <145 bpm — let legs wake up, relaxed shoulders
Z2 steady aerobic, 85-90 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm — conversational pace, upright posture, monitor back throughout
Z1 soft pedal, drop cadence, HR settle below 130 bpm — check back feels neutral

name: Light Back-Safe Upper Body & Core
focus: Bodyweight and light dumbbell work — anti-rotation core, arm strength, zero spinal flexion
notes: 3 rounds: 10x Dead Bug (slow, controlled), 8/side Pallof Press 6kg (anti-rotation core), 10x Dumbbell Bent-Over Row 6kg (hinge at hips, neutral spine), 8/side Single-Leg Glute Bridge (glute activation, core brace), 10x Dumbbell Curl 6kg (arm strength), 10x Dumbbell Overhead Press 6kg (shoulder stability). 45s rest between exercises, 60s between rounds. Stop any movement that causes back discomfort.

steps.description: Cat-cow 10 reps (gentle spinal mobility), hip circles 10 each direction, arm circles 10 each direction, bodyweight glute bridge 15 reps, scapular push-ups 10 reps
Dead Bug x10 → Pallof Press 6kg x8/side → Dumbbell Bent-Over Row 6kg x10 → Single-Leg Glute Bridge x8/side → Dumbbell Curl 6kg x10 → Dumbbell Overhead Press 6kg x10. 45s rest between exercises.
60 seconds rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check spine feels neutral
Child's pose on fists 45s (no lumbar flexion), standing quad stretch 30s/side, shoulders and chest stretch 30s
